tweaks.description: Moves the clock forward in March and back in November, so you never have to change it by hand.

tweaks.description: When the head unit starts and it's below 50°F outside, turns on the heated steering wheel and the driver's seat. Switching the car off and on doesn't always restart the head unit, so it may not run on every drive.
tweaks.name: Cold-start heat

needs.reason: Read the outside temperature from the climate system
Turn on the heated steering wheel
Turn on the heated driver's seat

tweaks.summary: Turns on the heated wheel and driver's seat when it's cold

tweaks.description: Skips the screen you have to confirm every time you start the car. Takes effect after the head unit restarts, and turning it off brings the screen back.
tweaks.name: Skip start-up screen

needs.reason: Change the head unit's status bar and start-up screen software so it skips the start-up screen
Replace the ready-to-run copy of that software to match

tweaks.summary: Goes straight to the home screen when you start the car
